description: Simplify ym-sync to save all tracks as .m4a (native macOS playback). FLAC-in-MP4 and AAC-in-MP4 are both .m4a and play natively. Only convert via ffmpeg if raw FLAC is returned.
steps: Update downloader.py: rename download_track_flac to download_track, handle Container.MP4 (save as .m4a, tag with mutagen.mp4.MP4), Container.FLAC (save as .flac, tag with mutagen.flac.FLAC), Container.MP3 (save as .mp3). Return dataclass with path, container, needs_conversion.
Update converter.py: rename convert_to_alac to convert_flac_to_alac (fallback only). Add copy_to_exported() function for copying .m4a files from Downloaded to Exported.

Update cli.py: simplify flow - download track (usually .m4a), save to Downloaded, copy to Exported (flat). Only convert via ffmpeg if raw FLAC. Remove complex retry logic. Remove --download-only flag.
Update README.md to reflect simplified flow (no ffmpeg required in normal operation).
acceptance_criteria: pip install -e . succeeds without import errors
python -m ym_sync --help displays updated usage information
Downloader handles Container.MP4, Container.FLAC, and Container.MP3
Converter has copy_to_exported and convert_flac_to_alac functions
CLI flow: download -> save to Downloaded -> copy/convert to Exported
verification: Run: pip install -e /projects/sandbox/qwerf/ and confirm exit code 0
Run: python3 -m ym_sync --help and confirm it shows updated usage
Run: python3 -c 'from ym_sync import api, client, downloader, converter, sync_state, cli' to confirm all modules import cleanly
Run: python3 -c 'from ym_sync.downloader import download_track, DownloadResult; from ym_sync.converter import copy_to_exported, convert_flac_to_alac'
